images.description: A layer of Nimbostratus covers the sky and completely hides the sun. Below this layer are a few patches of Stratus fractus at such locations as 1, 2 and 3. Rain is falling at the time of the picture. A cold front had passed over the area earlier in the day, but a wave forming to the south-west had brought a return of middle cloud and rain for a time.
images.location: Bracknell, Bracknell Forest, United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
